sources: Owner-approved twin-valley story and art plan, 17 November 2026
name: The Windward Cave
description: A sheltered cave at the valley's extreme northwestern ridge, with an open threshold, a small hearth and a fold outside.
arrival: Three heads turn together at the cave mouth. Yamantaka makes room beside the windbreak. Beyond him Mirlepa sits in the lee of the rock; the dust reaches his feet and settles.

sub_locations.name: The open threshold
sub_locations.description: A clear passage between the windbreak and the hearth.

sub_locations.name: The meditation alcove
sub_locations.description: A dry sheltered shelf with room to sit without blocking the doorway.

sub_locations.name: The resting fold
sub_locations.description: Low hurdles outside the sleeping place, empty between the herder's visits.

notes: Permanent High Camp-like home; visitors rotate, the cave and two Denisovan residents do not. No separate interior field map.
